items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, let me ask you something before you get up there. You're saying something about Joe Strutter back there. [INTERVIEWEE] No, I used to play them slide whistle.

ctx.x: No. That's why I was talking about that thing here about a little, what is it? A little mumble girl or something like that. Just put it in there. I was out of this bunch. I'm looking for something I can't find.
Well, let me ask you something before you get up there. You're saying something about Joe Strutter back there.
No, I used to play them slide whistle.
